rules.statement: Attack skills use weapon or unarmed attack mechanics and are affected by attack-specific modifiers.
Spell skills use spell mechanics and are affected by spell-specific modifiers; spells cannot be evaded by Evasion.
The Projectile tag identifies skills whose effects use projectile behavior; projectile-specific modifiers require this scope.
The Area of Effect tag identifies skills with area effects; area damage and area-of-effect modifiers are separate concepts.
A skill triggered by a trigger mechanism does not count as the character using a skill for conditions that specifically require using a skill.
Totems, traps, and mines use skills indirectly; whether an effect is attributed to the character or the proxy depends on the specific wording and mechanic.
A Support Gem affects socketed active skills only when the support is compatible and linked according to the item's socket links.
Aura skills can reserve a resource; the reserved amount is affected by the skill, reservation efficiency, and applicable modifiers.
